common.readOnly: Read-only: editing from the dashboard is turned off (DASHBOARD_EDIT_ENABLED is not true).

markup.rest1: for a link, a blank line for a new paragraph, lines starting with
markup.rest2: for a list. HTML is not supported (tags show as typed text). Words in braces like
markup.rest3: are filled in by the website: keep the same ones as the English text.

home.title: Website
home.help: Change the website's text in every language and replace its images, without code. Changes are live as soon as you save. Each text group is one part of the site; open one to see and edit its texts.
home.byGroupHelp: Per language: texts translated / all texts. **To update**: the English text changed after the translation was made. **Missing**: the website shows English there. English shows how many texts you edited.
home.notHereHelp: The legal pages (Privacy Policy, Terms, Legal notice, Contact, Withdrawal) are legal texts: they are edited in code and reviewed, not here. They exist in English only.

ns.title: Texts: {ns}
ns.help: Every text in this group with the English text and the {lang} text. Open a text to edit it.

key.historyError: The history could not be loaded (database). Reload the page to try again.
key.fromEnglish: No text in this language: the website shows English
key.resetConfirm: Reset the {lang} text to the default?
key.help: One text of the website in every language. Saving makes it live right away; "Reset to default" brings back the original text.
key.englishEdited: The website shows your English edit instead (below). Translations made before it are marked "Needs update".

images.title: Website images
images.help: The images the website uses. An upload is converted (metadata such as camera or location data is removed) and fitted to the slot's size: an image in another shape is cropped at the edges. Live right away; browsers may show the old image for up to 5 minutes.
images.replace: Replace (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {mb} MB)
